frameworks_concepts.name: Compute-efficient frontier
frameworks_concepts.summary: The empirical lower-loss boundary no model has crossed at a given compute budget

frameworks_concepts.name: Neural scaling laws
frameworks_concepts.summary: Power-law relationships between loss and compute, data, or model size

frameworks_concepts.name: Petaflop-day
frameworks_concepts.summary: One quadrillion FLOPs/sec sustained for 24 hours — the canonical unit for AI training scale

frameworks_concepts.name: Cross-entropy loss
frameworks_concepts.summary: Negative log probability of the true token; the standard LLM training objective

frameworks_concepts.name: Entropy of natural language
frameworks_concepts.summary: Irreducible ambiguity in next-word prediction that lower-bounds achievable loss

frameworks_concepts.name: Manifold hypothesis
frameworks_concepts.summary: Real data occupies a low-dimensional manifold inside a high-dimensional input space

frameworks_concepts.name: Resolution-limited scaling
frameworks_concepts.summary: Theory deriving the -4/d cross-entropy scaling exponent from manifold geometry

frameworks_concepts.name: Intrinsic dimension
frameworks_concepts.summary: True dimensionality of a dataset's manifold — estimated ~100 for natural language

frameworks_concepts.name: Emergent capabilities
frameworks_concepts.summary: Skills like arithmetic and reasoning that appear discontinuously with scale
